title: Open the PcbDoc next to an output job's export folder
summary: Finds the .PcbDoc in the base folder of an output job's export path and opens it with IClient.OpenDocument, and shows how an extension registers its own process with CommandLauncher.RegisterCommand in the shim.
phrasings: open a PCB document from code
find the board for an export folder
register a custom process in an extension
count documents of a kind in the focused project

commands.name: FileImportDirectory
commands.description: Open the first .PcbDoc (by name) of the folder before the 'Unit Output files' segment of BaseExportPath. Also reachable as the shim process ImportPcbFromOutputDir:FileImportDirectory with the same parameters.

commands.name: CheckDocumentKind
commands.description: Report whether the focused project is Free Documents and how many of its logical documents have DM_DocumentKind = Kind
